items.Sentence: The headworks and primary treatment system at the Facility consists of a three-stage screening process (fine screening, grit removal, ultra-fine screening)
The headworks and primary treatment system at the Facility consists of a three-stage screening process (fine screening, grit removal, ultra-fine screening)

a 950,000-gallon influent equalization tank used to allow a constant flow ... by storing a portion of the influent flow received during peak flow period of the day and returning the stored wastewater for treatment during low flow periods
each treatment train consisting of an anoxic basin followed by an aeration basin
each treatment train consisting of an anoxic basin followed by an aeration basin

a membrane bioreactor (MBR) system (operating in parallel), consisting of four total (three installed and one for future use) membrane tanks ... provides liquid-solid separation by a selective membrane barrier
four total (three installed and one for future use) membrane tanks (each tank contains four modules)
the Facility injects sodium hypochlorite solution to disinfect prior to entering the chlorine contact basin and dechlorinates using sodium bisulfite prior to discharge to the San Joaquin River
An emergency storage basin is used to temporarily hold influent flows exceeding the capacity of the headworks
The Facility will also utilize cooling ponds after dechlorination as needed to cool the effluent prior to discharge to the San Joaquin River
The waste activated sludge (WAS) generated from the CTF is pumped to a 190,000-gallon aerobic sludge storage tank
the existing sludge handling facilities include two belt filter press units housed in the dewatering building
a concrete pad for “air drying” of the dewatered sludge
Transportation and disposal/reuse of the biosolids is regulated by U.S. EPA under 40 C.F.R. part 503
